name: Food Spoilage, Preservation, Cooking & Food Safety Runtime
design_rules: food spoilage depends on elapsed time and storage temperature
high-moisture animal foods spoil faster than dry foods
cooking greatly reduces pathogen risk but does not sterilize all food forever
drying smoking and salting extend shelf life by reducing favorable spoilage conditions
preservation methods may alter moisture and nutrient retention
unsafe spoiled food may still provide calories while increasing illness risk
food safety state persists across world time
food safety never uses emissive or glow feedback
